discrepancies: doc/api/zlib.md:1671-1676 lists `zipEntry.rawContent([options])` (a method returning a Promise) as `added: v26.8.0` with no `changes:` entry. On v26.13.0, `rawContent` is a getter that returns the retained stored bytes (Buffer) or null for file-backed entries. The method form and rawContentSync/rawContentIterator arrived in v27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 (commit 7622ebb3d73, #66801).

doc/api/zlib.md:1906-1919 (zipFile.close, EBADF at :1918) says entries and methods used after close fail with system-level errors such as EBADF. v26.13.0 and main throw ERR_INVALID_STATE ('cannot read a ZipEntry after its backing ZipFile has been closed') from entry.content(), zipFile.get() and zipFile.stream().

doc/api/zlib.md:1732-2148 (Class: zlib.ZipFile) does not document Symbol.asyncDispose/Symbol.dispose or Symbol.iterator. Both are present on v26.13.0 and main: disposal closes the file, and iteration yields [name, Promise<ZipEntry>].
